تزدلفوا (form VIII)
# تَزْدَلِفُوا (tazdalifū) /taz.da.li.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
# تُزْدَلَفُوا (tuzdalafū) /tuz.da.la.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
